pages.text: Day 2. I set up a $(item)Research Terminal$() to keep my thinking in order: it opens the research tree. Each node costs Insight and sometimes materials, and needs its prerequisites.

Machines refuse to run recipes I have not researched - a machine checks the research of whoever placed it.$(br2)For pack makers: this can be turned off in the config, entries can be edited in $(thing)data/*/ts_research$(), and research can be granted with $(thing)/theoreticalsciences research grant$().
Handy trick: sneak-use this Codex to open the research tree from anywhere. I no longer walk back to the terminal every time an idea strikes.
